prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [139].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 139 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: Return only the pack from 307, since that room’s guest key was not used.
options.zh: 只放回 307 房的布巾包，因為該房未使用房客房卡。
options.whyZh: 307 房雖然未使用房客房卡，房務員卻扶門讓房客實際進入；布巾包仍密封也不能放回。

options.text: Return only the pack from 312, since no guest entered the room.
options.zh: 只放回 312 房的布巾包，因為沒有房客進入。
options.whyZh: 312 房確實沒有房客進入，但房務員已拆封，還是不符合放回條件。

options.text: Return only the pack from 304, even though the log shows use of a guest key.
options.zh: 只放回 304 房的布巾包，即使門鎖紀錄顯示使用過房客房卡。
options.whyZh: 304 房仍密封。房客九點看房時，房間要到十點才準備好；之後用房客房卡進去的是行李員，房客沒再上樓，因此符合放回條件。

options.text: Return neither sealed pack, since both rooms had a guest visit at some point.
options.zh: 兩包密封布巾都不要放回，因為兩間房都曾有房客進入。
options.whyZh: 是否曾進房不是唯一條件，還要看時間。304 房的房客在準備好之前就已離開，後來使用房客房卡的是行李員；307 房的房客才是在準備好之後走進去。

explanationZh: 304 房仍密封。房客九點看房時，房間要到十點才準備好；之後用房客房卡進去的是行李員，房客沒再上樓，因此符合放回條件。
evidence: An unopened spare linen pack can go back to the floor cupboard only if no guest has entered the room since the room was prepared. / A ‘guest key’ entry in the door log identifies the card used to open the door, not the person who carried it. / The guest stepped inside 304 at nine; the attendant prepared the room at ten. / The porter had borrowed it to put a suitcase inside and returned it to the guest in the lobby. / just after the attendant finished preparing the room, she held the door open while the guest stepped inside. / a new attendant broke its pack's seal to check the contents.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: An unopened spare linen pack can go back to the floor cupboard only if no guest has entered the room since the room was prepared.
A ‘guest key’ entry in the door log identifies the card used to open the door, not the person who carried it.
The guest stepped inside 304 at nine; the attendant prepared the room at ten.
The porter had borrowed it to put a suitcase inside and returned it to the guest in the lobby.
just after the attendant finished preparing the room, she held the door open while the guest stepped inside.
a new attendant broke its pack's seal to check the contents.

vocabulary.note: since 在這裡限定時間；之前進房和之後進房的判定不同。
